text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The U.N. special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, met Angolan Prime Minister Franca Van Dunem on Tuesday where Beye informed the Prime Minister that U.N. Secretary General Koffi Annan planned to visit Angola briefly in the future.

- The U.N.'s Blondin Beye on Tuesday met Justice Minister, Paulo Tjipilica, over the minister's comments at the weekend about U.N. personnel involvement in the sexual exploitation of children in Angola.
- The beginning of a plan to extend central administration to all of Angola's provinces is to start on February 28 in the town of Mbanza Congo in the country's Zaire province.
